App Shell: student dashboard / portal shell with left sidebar (with 'Certificates' navigation item active / highlighted with indigo background #4F46E5), top header bar with search, streak indicator '14 Day Streak' or '5 Day Streak', notification bell, and student avatar profile (Rahul Sharma, Pro Learner).

Page Content:
1. Breadcrumbs: Home / Student Portal / Certificates
2. Header Section:
   - Title: 'Certificates'
   - Subtitle / badge / meta: 'Earned by completing 100% of a course' with cloud sync / verified badge.
   - Quick stats row or summary counters:
     - 2 Verified Certificates Earned
     - 2 In Progress (Towards Certification)
     - 100% Authenticity Guarantee (SHA-256 Verified)
   - Action button on top right: 'Verify External Certificate' or 'Share Credentials Profile' (outlined secondary button)

3. Earned Certificates Section:
   - Section heading: 'Earned Certificates (2)' with a verified badge.
   - Two earned certificate cards side by side (2-column grid, responsive on large screens):
     * Card 1:
       - Designed like an elegant, high-prestige executive certificate plaque / diploma card with a crisp dual navy/gold subtle border frame, subtle guilloche/watermark motif or seal background.
       - Top: BICE Data Academy official crest/logo mark, 'Certificate of Completion', and an embossed gold/indigo verified badge with checkmark.
       - Recipient: 'This is proudly presented to' -> 'Rahul Sharma' (styled in an elegant, refined serif font, e.g. Georgia / Playfair style, large and distinguished).
       - Course Name: 'Advanced Excel Masterclass: Dynamic Arrays & Financial Modeling' (bold, high-contrast dark navy).
       - Details: Completion Date: 'October 14, 2024' • Grade / Distinction: 'Passed with 98% Capstone Distinction' • Issued by BICE Data Academy.
       - Instructor Signature line: Calligraphic / cursive signature representation with 'CA Rohan Mehta' (Lead Faculty & Former Deloitte Strategy Lead).
       - Accredited serial ID & badge: 'Certificate ID: BICE-2024-EXC-00124' with QR code icon / mini security seal and 'Verified & Cryptographically Signed'.
       - Action buttons below the certificate frame:
         * Primary Indigo Button: 'Download PDF' with download icon.
         * Outlined Secondary Button: 'Copy Verification Link' with link/copy icon.
         * Tertiary subtle button: 'Add to LinkedIn Profile'.
     * Card 2:
       - Second Certificate: Same elegant executive diploma aesthetic.
       - 'Certificate of Completion' presented to 'Rahul Sharma'.
       - Course Name: 'Python for Business Dashboards & Analytics' (or 'Executive BI Dashboards').
       - Details: Completion Date: 'August 29, 2024' • 100% Modules Completed.
       - Instructor Signature: 'David Kalu' (Head of Data Science) / 'Rachel Vance' (Director of BI).
       - Certificate ID: 'BICE-2024-PY-00089' with verified checkmark.
       - Actions: 'Download PDF' button, 'Copy Verification Link' button, 'Add to LinkedIn'.

4. 'Courses Close to Completion' Section:
   - Section title: 'Courses Close to Completion' with note/badge: 'Complete all lessons to receive your certificate'.
   - 2 progress card rows / cards:
     * Row 1:
       - Course title: 'Power Query & Automated ETL: Corporate Pipelines' (Intermediate • Automation & ETL)
       - Progress bar: 85% completed (22 of 26 lessons finished). Remaining: 4 lessons / 1 capstone project.
       - Estimated time to finish: ~2.5 hrs remaining.
       - Action button: 'Resume Course' (Indigo button).
     * Row 2:
       - Course title: 'SQL for Modern Data Analysis & Warehousing' (Intermediate • Data Warehousing)
       - Progress bar: 72% completed (29 of 40 lessons finished). Remaining: 11 lessons.
       - Estimated time to finish: ~5 hrs remaining.
       - Action button: 'Resume Course' (Indigo button).

5. Verification Explainer & Enterprise Trust Banner:
   - A clean card / banner explaining certificate verification:
     * Icon: Shield checkmark / security seal icon.
     * Heading: 'Public Certificate Verification & Employer Verification'
     * Body: 'Every credential issued by BICE Data Academy is immutably registered and can be verified by employers, recruitment teams, or universities anytime at bice.edu/verify-certificate/[id]. No login required for credential checkers.'
     * Direct test link / input sample: 'bice.edu/verify-certificate/BICE-2024-EXC-00124' with a quick 'Test Public Link' button.

Strict corporate SaaS design language matching Executive Analytics Academy design system: crisp Inter typography, rounded-xl cards, slate-50 section backgrounds, indigo-600 #4F46E5 primary CTA,
